_comment: OS-level operating policies (user-ordered 2026-10-17). These sit ABOVE brand configs and cannot be overridden by onboarding.

reference_intake_policy.rule: A new reference is NEVER saved from an image alone or a DNA JSON alone.
flow: 1. If only one half is provided (image OR json), ask the user for the other half — or offer to draft the missing DNA from the image for approval.

2. ANALYZE the pair against the existing library + rules BEFORE saving: schema validity, duplicate/near-duplicate check vs existing DNA, conflict check vs hard rules (purged-DNA tombstones, brand restrictions, platform policies), and image<->json agreement (the JSON must actually describe THAT image).
3. Only after the analysis passes AND the user approves does the entry enter the active registry; otherwise it stays in pending_intake with findings reported.
reference_intake_policy.never: silently merge new references into the active library

icon_sourcing_policy.rule: Icons/logos of software, tools, social platforms, TV channels, or well-known people are sourced in REALTIME from the web (official vectors/PNGs preferred, e.g. Iconify/simple-icons/brand press kits) — never drawn from memory or invented.
icon_sourcing_policy.recolor: Generic icons and vectors MAY be recolored to brand colors. Third-party company logos keep official colors unless the design is explicitly monochrome — never distort or redraw a trademark.
icon_sourcing_policy.selection: Pick the variant most suitable for the design (weight, style, filled/outline) and keep all icons in one design from one consistent style family.
icon_sourcing_policy.notes: Iconify requires a Mozilla User-Agent header. Engagement trio (Save/Repost/Like) always uses the brand's own icon set, never sourced.

background_system_policy.rule: Each brand locks exactly 3 background variants; every creative uses one. ONE variant family per carousel (QA 26). DNA gates what each variant may be.
background_system_policy.variant_A_primary: Default/dominant background of the series — the recognizable visual foundation. May be a solid brand color, a neutral, a texture, or an image-led background depending on the approved DNA.
background_system_policy.variant_B_contrast: A charcoal, light, or complementary variation ALREADY permitted by the DNA. For emphasis, contrast, or alternating sections — never a different design language.
background_system_policy.variant_C_expressive: A texture, collage, photographic scene, gradient, or other treatment — ONLY if the selected DNA allows it. Not an excuse to mix in an unrelated style.

sample_brand_defaults.A: warm cream #F5EFE6 flat / subtle paper grain
sample_brand_defaults.C: DNA-gated expressive (orange #FF5A00 field, paper texture, collage, duotone photo — per selected DNA)
